purpose: Test-only exact reviewed bounded/stage workflow reversal to immutable 166 custody oracle; no production workflow substitution.

files.before:
name: 3-4 - Docker QA

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Docker QA changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      should-run: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.should-run }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Detect runtime-impacting file changes
        id: filter
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CURRENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "should-run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            MERGE_BASE="$(git merge-base "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")"
            CHANGED_FILES="$(git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE" "$HEAD_SHA")"
          else
            if [ "$BEFORE_SHA" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
              CHANGED_FILES="$(git ls-tree -r --name-only "$CURRENT_SHA")"
            else
              CHANGED_FILES="$(git diff --name-only "$BEFORE_SHA" "$CURRENT_SHA")"
            fi
          fi

          printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES"

          # Conservatively test Git-quoted paths (e.g. names containing newlines or non-ASCII).
          if grep -E '^("|\.github/compatibility-versions\.json|\.github/workflows/|docker-compose(\.release)?\.yml|scripts/|tests/|includes/|webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp\.php|readme\.txt|composer\.(json|lock)|phpcs\.xml\.dist|phpstan\.neon\.dist|phpunit\.xml\.dist|assets/)' <<< "$CHANGED_FILES" > /dev/null; then
            echo "should-run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            status=$?
            if [ "$status" -ne 1 ]; then
              echo "Runtime change detection failed." >&2
              exit "$status"
            fi
            echo "should-run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  ability-contract-qa:
    name: 3 - Ability Contract QA
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.should-run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp-contract-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
      MYSQL_PORT: 0
      WORDPRESS_PORT: 0
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      wordpress-image: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.wordpress-image }}
      wordpress-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.wordpress-version }}
      php-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.php-version }}
      mysql-image: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.mysql-image }}
      mysql-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.mysql-version }}
      mcp-adapter-release: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.mcp-adapter-release }}
      mcp-adapter-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.mcp-adapter-version }}
      yoast-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.yoast-version }}
      seopress-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.seopress-version }}
      plugin-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.plugin-version }}
      registered-abilities: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.registered-abilities }}
      covered-abilities: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.covered-abilities }}
      test-cases: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.test-cases }}
      negative-cases: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.negative-cases }}
      passed-cases: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.passed-cases }}
      failed-cases: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.failed-cases }}
      debug-log-status: ${{ steps.debug-log.outputs.status }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up host QA PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Bind canonical host QA interpreter
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="$(readlink -e /usr/bin/php8.4)"
          test "${binary##*/}" = php8.4
          printf 'WSTM108_HOST_PHP=%s\n' "$binary" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Record executed workflow identity
        if: github.repository == 'DanielBoring/webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp'
        env:
          WSTM_CUSTODY_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_REPOSITORY_ID: ${{ github.repository_id }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_PULL_REQUEST_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'none' }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_COMMIT: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/e2e-qa.yml
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
        run: php tests/support/private-custody-context.php

      - name: Set up Docker Compose
        run: docker compose version

      - name: Start WordPress stack
        run: |
          bash scripts/destructive-retention.sh check
          docker compose down -v --remove-orphans
          docker compose up -d

      - name: Run Ability Contract QA
        id: qa
        env:
          WSTM108_HOST_AUTHORITY_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: bash scripts/e2e-test.sh contract

      - name: Upload isolated trash safety results
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: trash-safety-results
          path: e2e-artifacts/trash-safety-*.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Collect tested versions and contract summary
        id: versions
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          wordpress_image="$(docker compose config | awk '$1 == "image:" && $2 ~ /^wordpress:/ { print $2; exit }')"
          mysql_image="$(docker compose config | awk '$1 == "image:" && $2 ~ /^mysql:/ { print $2; exit }')"
          wordpress_version="$(docker compose exec -T wordpress wp --allow-root core version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          php_version="$(docker compose exec -T wordpress php -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          mysql_version="$(docker compose exec -T mysql mysql --version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          mcp_adapter_release="$(jq -r '"v" + .mcp_adapter' .github/compatibility-versions.json)"
          mcp_adapter_version="$(docker compose exec -T wordpress wp --allow-root plugin get mcp-adapter --field=version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          yoast_version="$(docker compose exec -T wordpress wp --allow-root plugin get wordpress-seo --field=version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          seopress_version="$(docker compose exec -T wordpress wp --allow-root plugin get wp-seopress --field=version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          plugin_version="$(docker compose exec -T wordpress wp --allow-root plugin get webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp --field=version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          summary_file="e2e-artifacts/e2e-summary.json"
          registered_abilities="$(jq -r '.registered_abilities // "unknown"' "$summary_file" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          covered_abilities="$(jq -r '.covered_abilities // "unknown"' "$summary_file" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          test_cases="$(jq -r '.test_cases // "unknown"' "$summary_file" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          negative_cases="$(jq -r '.negative_cases // "unknown"' "$summary_file" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          passed_cases="$(jq -r '.passed // "unknown"' "$summary_file" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          failed_cases="$(jq -r '.failed // "unknown"' "$summary_file" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
          {
            echo "wordpress-image=${wordpress_image:-unknown}"
            echo "wordpress-version=${wordpress_version:-unknown}"
            echo "php-version=${php_version:-unknown}"
            echo "mysql-image=${mysql_image:-unknown}"
            echo "mysql-version=${mysql_version:-unknown}"
            echo "mcp-adapter-release=${mcp_adapter_release:-unknown}"
            echo "mcp-adapter-version=${mcp_adapter_version:-unknown}"
            echo "yoast-version=${yoast_version:-unknown}"
            echo "seopress-version=${seopress_version:-unknown}"
            echo "plugin-version=${plugin_version:-unknown}"
            echo "registered-abilities=${registered_abilities:-unknown}"
            echo "covered-abilities=${covered_abilities:-unknown}"
            echo "test-cases=${test_cases:-unknown}"
            echo "negative-cases=${negative_cases:-unknown}"
            echo "passed-cases=${passed_cases:-unknown}"
            echo "failed-cases=${failed_cases:-unknown}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check WordPress debug log for errors
        id: debug-log
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! docker compose exec -T wordpress test -f /var/www/html/wp-content/debug.log; then
            echo "status=no_debug_log" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if docker compose exec -T wordpress grep -Eiq 'fatal error|parse error|uncaught|php (fatal error|parse error|warning|notice|deprecated)|deprecated|warning|notice|error' /var/www/html/wp-content/debug.log; then
            echo "status=error_entries_found" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "status=no_error_entries" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Publish contract job summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: php scripts/docker-qa-summary.php e2e-artifacts/e2e-summary.json build/qa-summary-contract.json contract

      - name: Clean up
        if: always()
        run: bash scripts/destructive-retention.sh cleanup

      - name: Upload contract summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: ability-contract-summary
          path: |
            build/qa-summary-contract.json
            e2e-artifacts/media-download-fixed.json
            e2e-artifacts/media-server-fixed.jsonl
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload scheduling regression evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: scheduling-regression
          path: e2e-artifacts/scheduling-regression.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload taxonomy write regression evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: taxonomy-write-summary
          path: e2e-artifacts/taxonomy-write-summary.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload patch HTML regression evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: patch-html-regression-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/patch-html-summary.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload detailed parent contract evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: parent-assignment-contract-evidence
          path: |
            e2e-artifacts/parent-assignment-direct.json
            e2e-artifacts/parent-assignment-ability.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload standalone metadata contract evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: post-meta-authorization-contract-evidence
          path: |
            e2e-artifacts/post-meta-authorization-direct.json
            e2e-artifacts/post-meta-authorization-ability.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload metadata boundary contract evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: metadata-boundary-contract-evidence
          path: |
            e2e-artifacts/metadata-batch-direct.json
            e2e-artifacts/metadata-batch-ability.json
            e2e-artifacts/seo-metadata-direct.json
            e2e-artifacts/seo-metadata-ability.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload comment contract evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: comment-contract-evidence
          path: |
            e2e-artifacts/comments-direct.json
            e2e-artifacts/comments-ability.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload destructive safety contract evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: destructive-safety-contract-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/destructive-*/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify independently published untrusted export
        id: untrusted-export-check
        if: ${{ always() && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready == 'true' && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status == 'published' }}
        env:
          WSTM108_EXPORT_ROOT: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}
          WSTM108_EXPORT_SHA256: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_manifest_sha256 }}
          WSTM108_EXPORT_CUSTODY: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_custody }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_EXPORT_PARENT: ${{ runner.temp }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_PROJECT: ${{ env.COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_RUN: ${{ github.run_id }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$WSTM108_EXPECTED_SOURCE"
          "${WSTM108_HOST_PHP-php}" scripts/untrusted-export.php verify-published
      - name: Upload only the closed safe untrusted export
        id: untrusted-export-upload
        if: ${{ always() && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready == 'true' && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status == 'published' && steps.untrusted-export-check.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: untrusted-contract-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-proof.json
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-failure-witnesses.json
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-export-manifest.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Require QA and safe evidence success
        id: untrusted-required-evidence
        if: always()
        env:
          QA_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.qa.outcome }}
          EXPORT_READY: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready }}
          EXPORT_STATUS: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status }}
          PROOF_STATUS: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_proof_status }}
          EXPORT_CHECK: ${{ steps.untrusted-export-check.outcome }}
          EXPORT_UPLOAD: ${{ steps.untrusted-export-upload.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$QA_OUTCOME" = success
          test "$EXPORT_READY" = true
          test "$EXPORT_STATUS" = published
          test "$PROOF_STATUS" = passed
          test "$EXPORT_CHECK" = success
          test "$EXPORT_UPLOAD" = success
      - name: Upload canonical error contract evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: error-contract-ability-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/error-contract.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload database privacy native evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: database-privacy-native-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/database-table-privacy-native.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  full-mcp-e2e-qa:
    name: 4 - Full MCP E2E QA
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.should-run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp-e2e-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
      MYSQL_PORT: 0

    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up host QA PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: posix
          coverage: none

      - name: Bind canonical host QA interpreter
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binary="$(readlink -e /usr/bin/php8.4)"
          test "${binary##*/}" = php8.4
          printf 'WSTM108_HOST_PHP=%s\n' "$binary" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Record executed workflow identity
        if: github.repository == 'DanielBoring/webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp'
        env:
          WSTM_CUSTODY_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_REPOSITORY_ID: ${{ github.repository_id }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_PULL_REQUEST_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'none' }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_COMMIT: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/e2e-qa.yml
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
        run: php tests/support/private-custody-context.php

      - name: Set up Docker Compose
        run: docker compose version

      - name: Start WordPress stack
        run: |
          bash scripts/destructive-retention.sh check
          docker compose down -v --remove-orphans
          docker compose up -d

      - name: Run Full MCP E2E QA
        id: qa
        env:
          WSTM108_HOST_AUTHORITY_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: bash scripts/e2e-test.sh e2e

      - name: Publish transport job summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: php scripts/docker-qa-summary.php e2e-artifacts/mcp-crud-summary.json build/qa-summary-transport.json transport

      - name: Clean up
        if: always()
        run: bash scripts/destructive-retention.sh cleanup

      - name: Upload transport summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: full-mcp-e2e-summary
          path: |
            build/qa-summary-transport.json
            e2e-artifacts/mcp-crud-summary.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload detailed parent HTTP evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: parent-assignment-http-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/parent-assignment-http.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload standalone metadata HTTP evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: post-meta-authorization-http-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/post-meta-authorization-http.json

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:

            e2e-artifacts/metadata-batch-individual.json
            e2e-artifacts/seo-metadata-http.json
            e2e-artifacts/seo-metadata-individual.json

        with:

          path: e2e-artifacts/comments-http.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload destructive safety HTTP evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: destructive-safety-http-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/destructive-*/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify independently published untrusted export
        id: untrusted-export-check
        if: ${{ always() && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready == 'true' && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status == 'published' }}
        env:
          WSTM108_EXPORT_ROOT: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}
          WSTM108_EXPORT_SHA256: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_manifest_sha256 }}
          WSTM108_EXPORT_CUSTODY: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_custody }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_EXPORT_PARENT: ${{ runner.temp }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_PROJECT: ${{ env.COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_RUN: ${{ github.run_id }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$WSTM108_EXPECTED_SOURCE"
          "${WSTM108_HOST_PHP-php}" scripts/untrusted-export.php verify-published
      - name: Upload only the closed safe untrusted export
        id: untrusted-export-upload
        if: ${{ always() && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready == 'true' && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status == 'published' && steps.untrusted-export-check.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: untrusted-http-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-proof.json
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-failure-witnesses.json
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-export-manifest.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Require QA and safe evidence success
        id: untrusted-required-evidence
        if: always()
        env:
          QA_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.qa.outcome }}
          EXPORT_READY: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready }}
          EXPORT_STATUS: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status }}
          PROOF_STATUS: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_proof_status }}
          EXPORT_CHECK: ${{ steps.untrusted-export-check.outcome }}
          EXPORT_UPLOAD: ${{ steps.untrusted-export-upload.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$QA_OUTCOME" = success
          test "$EXPORT_READY" = true
          test "$EXPORT_STATUS" = published
          test "$PROOF_STATUS" = passed
          test "$EXPORT_CHECK" = success
          test "$EXPORT_UPLOAD" = success
      - name: Upload canonical error HTTP evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: error-contract-http-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/error-contract.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload database privacy HTTP evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: database-privacy-http-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/database-table-privacy-http.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  docker-qa-gate:
    name: Docker QA gate
    needs: [changes, ability-contract-qa, full-mcp-e2e-qa]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gate predicate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require successful detector and expected runtime results
        env:
          DETECTOR: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          SHOULD_RUN: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.should-run }}
          CONTRACT: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.result }}
          TRANSPORT: ${{ needs.full-mcp-e2e-qa.result }}
        run: php scripts/docker-qa-gate.php "$DETECTOR" "$SHOULD_RUN" "$CONTRACT" "$TRANSPORT"

  comment-pr:
    name: Docker QA PR comment
    needs: [changes, ability-contract-qa, full-mcp-e2e-qa]
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]' && github.event.pull_request.user.login != 'dependabot[bot]' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.should-run == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Comment Docker QA result on PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          REPO: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          CONTRACT_RESULT: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.result }}
          E2E_RESULT: ${{ needs.full-mcp-e2e-qa.result }}
          REGISTERED_ABILITIES: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.registered-abilities }}
          COVERED_ABILITIES: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.covered-abilities }}
          TEST_CASES: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.test-cases }}
          NEGATIVE_CASES: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.negative-cases }}
          PASSED_CASES: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.passed-cases }}
          FAILED_CASES: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.failed-cases }}
          DEBUG_LOG_STATUS: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.debug-log-status }}
          WORDPRESS_IMAGE: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.wordpress-image }}
          WORDPRESS_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.wordpress-version }}
          PHP_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.php-version }}
          MYSQL_IMAGE: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.mysql-image }}
          MYSQL_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.mysql-version }}
          MCP_ADAPTER_RELEASE: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.mcp-adapter-release }}
          MCP_ADAPTER_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.mcp-adapter-version }}
          YOAST_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.yoast-version }}
          SEOPRESS_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.seopress-version }}
          PLUGIN_VERSION: ${{ needs.ability-contract-qa.outputs.plugin-version }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BODY=$'## Docker QA Summary\n\n'
          BODY+="- Ability Contract QA: ${CONTRACT_RESULT:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Full MCP E2E QA: ${E2E_RESULT:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- PR head commit: ${PR_HEAD_SHA:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Tested merge commit: ${TESTED_SHA:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- WordPress debug log scan: ${DEBUG_LOG_STATUS:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Workflow run: ${RUN_URL:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+=$'\n### Ability Contract Coverage\n\n'
          BODY+="- Registered webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp abilities: ${REGISTERED_ABILITIES:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Manifest-covered abilities: ${COVERED_ABILITIES:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Manifest test cases: ${TEST_CASES:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Manifest cases passed: ${PASSED_CASES:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Manifest cases failed: ${FAILED_CASES:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Negative permission cases: ${NEGATIVE_CASES:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+=$'\n### Tested Runtime\n\n'
          BODY+="- WordPress Docker image: ${WORDPRESS_IMAGE:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- WordPress core: ${WORDPRESS_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- PHP: ${PHP_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- MySQL Docker image: ${MYSQL_IMAGE:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- MySQL server: ${MYSQL_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- MCP Adapter release: ${MCP_ADAPTER_RELEASE:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- MCP Adapter plugin: ${MCP_ADAPTER_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Yoast SEO plugin: ${YOAST_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- SEOPress plugin: ${SEOPRESS_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          BODY+="- Webmastery Site Toolkit for MCP: ${PLUGIN_VERSION:-unknown}"$'\n'
          gh api "repos/$OWNER/$REPO/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER/comments" --method POST -f body="$BODY"

  skip-summary:
    name: Docker QA skip summary
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.should-run == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Report skipped Docker QA
        run: |
          echo "Docker QA skipped: no runtime-impacting files changed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: 5 - Release Package QA

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - '.github/compatibility-versions.json'
      - '.github/workflows/release.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/release-package-qa.yml'
      - 'docker-compose.yml'
      - 'docker-compose.release.yml'
      - 'scripts/qa-compose.sh'
      - 'scripts/e2e-test.sh'
      - 'scripts/build-release.sh'
      - 'scripts/release-qa.sh'
      - 'scripts/validate-release-package.php'
      - 'scripts/create-release-zip.php'
      - 'scripts/release-*.php'
      - 'scripts/release-*.sh'
      - 'scripts/test-release-*'
      - 'scripts/compatibility-baselines.php'
      - 'composer.json'
      - 'composer.lock'
      - '.wordpress-org/**'
      - 'tests/e2e/**'
      - 'webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp.php'
      - 'includes/**'
      - 'readme.txt'
      - 'CHANGELOG.md'
      - 'LICENSE'

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release-package-qa-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release-package-qa:
    name: 5 - Release Package QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 55
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2'
          extensions: zip
          coverage: none

      - name: Record executed workflow identity
        if: github.repository == 'DanielBoring/webmastery-site-toolkit-for-mcp'
        env:
          WSTM_CUSTODY_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_REPOSITORY_ID: ${{ github.repository_id }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_PULL_REQUEST_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'none' }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_COMMIT: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/release-package-qa.yml
          WSTM_CUSTODY_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
        run: php tests/support/private-custody-context.php

      - name: Test release safeguard regressions
        run: |
          php scripts/test-release-safeguards.php
          bash scripts/test-release-tag-check.sh
          bash scripts/test-release-plugin-check.sh
          bash scripts/test-release-runtime.sh
          php scripts/test-release-recovery.php
          bash scripts/test-release-control-check.sh
          bash scripts/test-release-publish-prerequisites.sh

      - name: Run Release Package QA
        id: qa
        env:
          COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: wstm-package-qa-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM108_HOST_AUTHORITY_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: bash scripts/release-qa.sh

      - name: Upload destructive safety package evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: destructive-safety-package-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/destructive-*/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify independently published untrusted export
        id: untrusted-export-check
        if: ${{ always() && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready == 'true' && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status == 'published' }}
        env:
          WSTM108_EXPORT_ROOT: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}
          WSTM108_EXPORT_SHA256: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_manifest_sha256 }}
          WSTM108_EXPORT_CUSTODY: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_custody }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_EXPORT_PARENT: ${{ runner.temp }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_PROJECT: wstm-package-qa-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_RUN: ${{ github.run_id }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          WSTM108_EXPECTED_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$WSTM108_EXPECTED_SOURCE"
          "${WSTM108_HOST_PHP-php}" scripts/untrusted-export.php verify-published
      - name: Upload only the closed safe untrusted export
        id: untrusted-export-upload
        if: ${{ always() && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready == 'true' && steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status == 'published' && steps.untrusted-export-check.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: untrusted-package-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-proof.json
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-failure-witnesses.json
            ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_root }}/untrusted-export-manifest.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Require QA and safe evidence success
        id: untrusted-required-evidence
        if: always()
        env:
          QA_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.qa.outcome }}
          EXPORT_READY: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_ready }}
          EXPORT_STATUS: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_export_status }}
          PROOF_STATUS: ${{ steps.qa.outputs.untrusted_proof_status }}
          EXPORT_CHECK: ${{ steps.untrusted-export-check.outcome }}
          EXPORT_UPLOAD: ${{ steps.untrusted-export-upload.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$QA_OUTCOME" = success
          test "$EXPORT_READY" = true
          test "$EXPORT_STATUS" = published
          test "$PROOF_STATUS" = passed
          test "$EXPORT_CHECK" = success
          test "$EXPORT_UPLOAD" = success
      - name: Upload standalone metadata package evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: post-meta-authorization-package-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/post-meta-authorization-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload canonical error package evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: error-contract-package-evidence
          path: e2e-artifacts/error-contract.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload metadata boundary package evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: metadata-boundary-package-evidence
          path: |
            e2e-artifacts/metadata-batch-*.json
            e2e-artifacts/seo-metadata-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload database privacy package evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: database-privacy-package-evidence
          path: |
            e2e-artifacts/database-table-privacy-native.json
            e2e-artifacts/database-table-privacy-http.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
